name: Manaslu Circuit over Larkya La
why: Round the eighth-highest mountain on Earth, up the gorge of the Budhi Gandaki into Tibetan villages and over the 5,106 m Larkya La, with far fewer people than the Annapurna.
book: Restricted area: Manaslu Restricted Area Permit, MCAP and ACAP permits, only through a licensed agency, with a licensed guide and at least two trekkers. Jeep from Kathmandu to Machha Khola (8-9 h).
water: Teahouses all the way, simpler than on the Annapurna.
dangers: Larkya La at 5,106 m: rest days at Samagaon and Samdo.
Long 8-10 h pass day from Dharamsala: leave by 04:00.
turnaround: Do not leave Dharamsala for the pass in a snowstorm, or later than 05:00.

points.name: Machha Khola
points.note: The village in the Budhi Gandaki gorge where the jeep road ends.

points.name: Namrung
points.note: The first Tibetan-style village, among barley fields and mani walls.

points.name: Samagaon
points.note: A big village at 3,530 m under Manaslu, with Pungyen gompa and Birendra lake nearby.

points.name: Larkya La
points.note: The 5,106 m pass of prayer flags, glaciers and ice peaks all round.

points.name: Dharapani
points.note: On the Marsyangdi side, where the circuit joins the Annapurna road.
